quarterly_data.quarter: Eli Lilly press release: Lilly's Zepbound (tirzepatide 10 mg and 15 mg) was (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: In a Lilly indirect treatment comparison of SURMOUNT-1 and STEP UP data (presented at EASD), Zepbound (tirzepatide) 15 mg and 10 mg were associated with 4.5% and 3.2% greater body-weight reduction than Wegovy HD (semaglutide injection 7.2 mg) at 72 weeks in adults with obesity using the treatment-regimen estimand; with the efficacy estimand the differences were 1.8% and 0.7% and did not reach statistical significance. Zepbound 15 mg had more than three times the odds (odds ratio 3.54, treatment-regimen estimand) and four times the odds (odds ratio 4.15, efficacy estimand) of at least 20% body-weight reduction versus Wegovy HD, and discontinuation due to adverse events was comparable. It adds to SURMOUNT-5, the head-to-head Phase 3b trial in which Zepbound 10 mg and 15 mg showed superior weight loss to Wegovy 1.7 mg and 2.4 mg.
